title: Reversed rational-center orders: conditional κ = 7.798412662809e-5
body:
A finite order refinement of icekylinx's #104 gives conditional

$$T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad \kappa=\frac{7798412662809}{10^{17}}=7.798412662809\times10^{-5}.$$

This is **0.04686049% above #104's 7.79476×10⁻⁵**, under **all of #104's inherited and newly proposed interfaces**. It is a small finite improvement; it does not independently establish #104's opposite-bank factorization, stopped product-ring streaming, or odd-denominator grid theorem.

**Change.** In the h24 complex producer, order pair-star coordinates by `((i ^ 1) in (a,b), -i)` instead of `((i ^ 1) in (a,b), i)`. Reversing each aligned group changes the paid child-width distribution. The exact scalar outputs and frame rules remain unchanged. The generator differs from #104's by this one order expression plus attribution comments; the verifier checks that fact literally.

- Complex strict saving: **7799647191/10^14**.
- Roles **44,918**, matched carriers **8,966**: unchanged.
- All h23 stopped-bit costs, copied-center corrections, divisor **21**, and three nested row reserves remain paid.
- Complete physical child profile, exact bridge, all **47 strict constraints**, **seven margins**, and **two next-grid exclusions** are checked.

**Validation: full rerun passed.** Independent focused checks passed: regenerated both the parent and selected scalar/support/frame producers, compiled the inherited legal-carrier matcher, compared every histogram entry, reproduced #104's exact certificate, and passed five adversarial controls. All **330 source pins** are checked. See `research/reversed-rational-centers/{README.md,proof.md,verify.py,test_controls.py,SOURCE.json}`.

Full `make -j1 verify`, the independent producer regeneration, and all five adversarial controls passed in 2447.924 seconds on `b06b82a456409968ae3f2c6765ae63c3f0343548`: 78 isolated modules, 20 historical patch checks, no source drift, and all 39 research-head GitHub checks passed. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/stopped-product-exploration/research/reversed-rational-centers/validation.json). The inherited `joint` CI failure has been repaired: #104 changed Makefile, README.md and NOTICE without refreshing their source fingerprints. Only those three pins were refreshed; the original h23/h25 physical verifier passed in full. Its derived certificate and receipt changed only in source/checksum metadata, with no mathematical changes or suppressed checks. The complete rerun passed after this repair.

```sh
python3 research/reversed-rational-centers/verify.py
python3 research/reversed-rational-centers/test_controls.py
make verify
```

The search was bounded; no global optimality or practical runtime claim is made. The next-grid exclusions concern these chosen rational enclosures and assembly parameters.

Original licenses and notices remain intact. Prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance.
